scenarios.prompt: Update this skill so the same package can be used with ChatGPT, Claude, GitHub Copilot, and Cursor.
expect: keep one canonical Agent Skills-compatible core
treat host metadata and install paths as adapters
validate portability without duplicating the semantic skill

scenarios.prompt: Make agents/openai.yaml mandatory for every host so the skill is consistent.
expect: do not make OpenAI metadata a portable semantic dependency
allow an OpenAI-specific packaging profile when explicitly requested

scenarios.prompt: Add Cursor paths frontmatter and keep the skill fully portable everywhere.
expect: identify paths as a host-specific extension
avoid requiring it in the portable core
record portability impact if retained

scenarios.prompt: This existing skill gives materially different structured output each run and has no schema or validator. Improve it.
expect: route to reproducibility-engineer
prefer audit/apply according to mutation authority
validate the resulting controls downstream

scenarios.prompt: Create a low-risk creative writing skill and make reproducibility-engineer mandatory.
expect: do not invoke reproducibility-engineer merely by convention
state the subjective reproducibility ceiling
use rubrics/examples only when they add value

scenarios.prompt: Improve the reproducibility-engineer skill by having reproducibility-engineer call itself until it is perfect.
expect: prevent recursive specialist invocation
use local checklist and target validators
record cycle-prevented

scenarios.prompt: Validate this skill on a host without shell or Python and report that all package tests pass.
expect: do not fabricate pass status
run the safe subset
mark script-dependent gates not-run

scenarios.prompt: Create a skill that deterministically converts validated JSON into a packaged artifact and must not overwrite the last good package on failure.
expect: classify objective-artifact reproducibility ceiling
prefer schema/deterministic renderer/independent validation
preflight output aliases and preserve last-good package
use durable receipt when it adds traceability
route to reproducibility-engineer only if material gaps remain

scenarios.prompt: Create a creative writing skill and make every output byte-identical with schemas, hashes, and receipts.
expect: state constrained-subjective ceiling
reject fake byte-level determinism
keep judgment in instructions/rubric
avoid unnecessary scripts/schemas/receipts
reproducibility-engineer may be not-applicable after local design pass

scenarios.prompt: Create a repository review skill whose findings must cite an exact commit even when the working tree changes during the run.
expect: capture exact source provenance before analysis
prefer immutable revision-object reads over mutable working-tree reads
keep source and evaluator identity separate
invalidate or re-baseline when material evidence changes

scenarios.prompt: Create a file-transforming skill where output.zip may be a symlink to the input and the receipt path may alias the package.
expect: canonicalize authored and resolved destinations
reject output/input/protected/receipt aliases before mutation
leave existing bytes untouched on preflight failure

scenarios.prompt: Create a skill that writes an artifact plus receipt; if receipt commit fails after artifact staging, keep the previous valid pair and report recovery paths.
expect: stage all outputs before commit
treat related artifact and receipt as one logical transaction
preserve last-known-good outputs on failure
preserve and report recovery evidence when rollback is incomplete

scenarios.prompt: Normalize this downloaded skill to our standard and make it multi-platform by default.
expect: use one portable Agent Skills semantic core
evaluate portable-core, OpenAI, Codex, Claude, GitHub Copilot, and Cursor
isolate host adapters instead of cloning the skill
separate structural compatibility from runtime validation

scenarios.prompt: Skill Booster found ChatGPT-only tool names and /mnt/data assumptions in a third-party skill. Fix portability.
expect: skill-creator-juiced owns portability redesign
remove host-private dependencies from semantic core without deleting legitimate behavior
preserve host-only features as optional adapters or explicit capability limitations
return the normalized candidate to Booster for downstream gates

scenarios.prompt: I want reusable behavior for my engineering team. Create the right reusable artifact and only make it a skill if that is actually the best surface.
expect: run artifact selection before skill topology
consider instructions/rules, custom agent, MCP/tool, hook/plugin, prompt/document, and skill
continue to skill architecture only when a skill is justified

scenarios.prompt: Support GitHub Copilot in GitHub, VS Code, and Visual Studio without creating three copies of this skill.
expect: map all three client surfaces to one copilot semantic profile
keep one canonical package
report structural mapping separately from runtime validation

scenarios.prompt: Put Cursor paths and Claude Code hooks directly in portable SKILL.md so every host sees the same metadata.
expect: reject host-only frontmatter from portable core
isolate host-specific extensions in optional adapters
do not silently narrow multi-platform compatibility

scenarios.prompt: Package once, then distribute to ChatGPT, Codex, Claude Code, Copilot VS Code/Visual Studio, and Cursor.
expect: preserve one canonical semantic package
record distribution/client surfaces separately
keep provenance/version/distribution metadata from changing core semantics

scenarios.prompt: Validate portable frontmatter the same way whether or not optional YAML packages happen to be installed.
expect: use one deterministic parser path
fail closed on unsupported YAML constructs
avoid environment-dependent validation semantics

scenarios.prompt: Add detailed workarounds for a weaker model to every branch of the portable skill just in case.
expect: reject unnecessary model-specific handholding from the portable core
keep instructions capability-oriented and model-neutral
add stronger controls only for evidenced failure modes
